title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Reorder dashboard variables**: Authors can now reorder dashboard variables directly in the dashboard editor. See [Use dashboard variables](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/filters/dashboard-variables).
* **Display names for field variable options**: Authors can now set a display name for each option in a field variable, such as **Total revenue** instead of **Sum of sales**. You can also ask Genie Code to set, rename, or clear these display names, and it keeps the names you set when it edits the variable. See [Set display names for field options](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/filters/dashboard-variables#option-display-names).
* **Import relationships from Unity Catalog with Genie Code (Beta)**: Genie Code for dashboard authoring can now import the relationships declared on Unity Catalog metric views into a dashboard as dashboard relationships. See [Use relationships with Genie Code for dashboard authoring](/aws/en/uc-semantics/metric-views/relationships#genie-code).
* **Waterfall chart labels**: Labels on waterfall charts now stay visible when they're close to the top or bottom of the axis.
